measured: 2026-10-23 settings page features list + 2026-10-26 WF.AppSettings.values.features, live upstream

visible.name: Workflowy Labs
visible.description: Give us feedback on new Workflowy features as they come out! Be the first to know about new features and help our team improve the product.

visible.name: Open links in desktop app
visible.description: When opening links in the browser, also open them in the desktop app. THIS DOES NOT APPLY TO MOBILE APPS.

visible.name: Dates
visible.description: Adding dates, Searching for dates, Date ranges

visible.name: Full width page
visible.description: Lines wrapping getting you down? Turn this on, and WorkFlowy will spread luxuriously across all the screen space you give it.

visible.name: Templates
visible.description: This lets you create and reuse complex structures in a convenient way

visible.name: Backlinks
visible.description:
When you create an internal link to another part of your Workflowy, it is tracked in a 'Backlinks' section at the bottom of the destination link/bullet. 
Use [[inline linking]] or copy/paste URLs to create internal links.

visible.name: Keep Mobile Keyboard on Scroll
visible.description: Keeps the soft keyboard open when you scroll the content above. Applicable only to mobile devices.

visible.name: Rich tags
visible.description: Allows emojis and some other characters in tags. Note: page reload is required to apply the changes to all your tags.

visible.name: Always show expand/collapse arrows
visible.description: Show expand/collapse buttons at all times, not just on hover. Page reload required.

visible.name: All updates
visible.label: LABS
visible.description:
Get updates info in a shared space.

Note: Page reload is required in order to make the feature work correctly.

visible.name: Fractal Comments
visible.description: Leave comments on any node in Workflowy. Comments have infinite threading so you can have deep, open-ended or infinitely detailed conversations.

visible.name: Dashboard layout
visible.label: LABS
visible.description: Adds a new Dashboard item type. This is an EARLY prototype, and IS NOT BEING ACTIVELY DEVELOPED.  Use at your own risk. NOTE: Page reload required to apply the feature toggle.

visible.name: Workflowy AI
visible.label: LABS
visible.description: Ask questions about your notes, discover new insights, and turn your ideas into action. (note: page reload is required).

visible.name: Instant Presentations
visible.label: LABS
visible.description:
Turn any outline into a presentation instantly by pressing the play button in the menu bar.
Page reload required.

visible.name: Nested search
visible.description:
Use '>' to build nested searches. 
"is:todo > #high" searches for items with #high that are descendants of 'is:todo' items at any depth.

visible.name: Recognize markdown pasting
visible.description: If the text you paste looks like Markdown, do our best to convert it to WorkFlowy formatting options

visible.name: Calendar
visible.description: Show a Calendar node and Today button in the header and sidebar to plan, journal, and take notes.

visible.name: Numbered List
visible.description: Turn a bullet into a numbered list that automatically renumbers when you add, delete, or reorder nodes.

visible.name: Tables
visible.description: Organise your data in rows and columns, making it easy to compare, sort, and manage lists of things.

visible.name: Panes
visible.description: Open nodes in separate panes to view and work with multiple parts of your WorkFlowy side by side.
